$comment: The registry of every Comfytosh port. The landing page and the port checks read this file. Add your port here in the same pull request that adds its folder; see CONTRIBUTING.md.

ports.name: VS Code
ports.install: Copy the vscode/ folder to ~/.vscode/extensions/comfytosh.comfytosh-theme-0.1.0/, restart, then run Preferences: Color Theme.

ports.name: Zed
ports.install: Copy zed/comfytosh.json to ~/.config/zed/themes/, then pick Comfytosh Screen or Comfytosh Case.

ports.name: Neovim
ports.install: Put nvim/lua and nvim/colors in your config, then require("comfytosh").setup() and vim.cmd.colorscheme("comfytosh"). It follows vim.o.background.

ports.name: Helix
ports.install: Copy helix/themes/*.toml to ~/.config/helix/themes/ and set theme = "comfytosh-screen".

ports.name: JetBrains IDEs
ports.install: Settings, Editor, Color Scheme, the gear icon, Import Scheme, then pick the .icls file.

ports.name: Sublime Text
ports.install: Copy both files to Packages/User/, then pick the scheme in Preferences, Select Color Scheme.

ports.name: Ghostty
ports.install: Copy ghostty/* to ~/.config/ghostty/themes/ and set theme = light:comfytosh-case,dark:comfytosh-screen.

ports.name: Alacritty
ports.install: Copy alacritty/*.toml to ~/.config/alacritty/themes/ and add it to general.import.

ports.name: Kitty
ports.install: Copy kitty/*.conf to ~/.config/kitty/themes/ and add include themes/comfytosh-screen.conf to kitty.conf.

ports.name: WezTerm
ports.install: Copy wezterm/colors/ next to wezterm.lua, set config.color_scheme_dirs and config.color_scheme = 'Comfytosh Screen'.

ports.name: iTerm2
ports.install: Settings, Profiles, Colors, Color Presets, Import, then pick the .itermcolors file.

ports.name: Windows Terminal
ports.install: Paste the two objects from windows-terminal/comfytosh.json into schemes in settings.json.

ports.name: Warp
ports.install: Copy warp/*.yaml to ~/.warp/themes/, then pick the theme in Settings, Appearance, Themes.

ports.name: tmux
ports.install: Save the files in your config and add source-file ~/.config/tmux/comfytosh-screen.conf to tmux.conf.

ports.name: Starship
ports.install: Paste the palette tables into starship.toml and set palette = "comfytosh_screen".

ports.name: bat
ports.install: Copy bat/*.tmTheme to "$(bat --config-dir)/themes", run bat cache --build and set --theme="comfytosh-screen".

ports.name: fzf
ports.install: Source fzf/comfytosh-screen.sh from your shell rc to set FZF_DEFAULT_OPTS.

ports.name: lazygit
ports.install: Merge the gui.theme block from lazygit/comfytosh-screen.yml into your lazygit config.yml.

ports.name: btop
ports.install: Copy btop/*.theme to ~/.config/btop/themes/ and set color_theme = "comfytosh-screen" in btop.conf.

ports.name: Obsidian
ports.install: Copy the obsidian/ folder to .obsidian/themes/Comfytosh/ in your vault, then pick it under Appearance. Light mode is Case, dark mode is Screen.

ports.name: Omarchy
ports.install: Copy omarchy/comfytosh-screen and omarchy/comfytosh-case to ~/.config/omarchy/themes/, then omarchy-theme-set comfytosh-screen.
